project.name: The Salt Cartographer
project.description: A surveyor returns to a harbor whose coast is moving.

characters.name: Ilse Marrow
characters.secrets: She cut the lighthouse lens herself and has told no one.

characters.name: Tamsin Roke
characters.personality: Quick, proud, eager to be trusted.
characters.secrets: She believes the lens was lost in the storm.

characters.name: Brann Ocque
characters.secrets: He is Ilse's brother, and the harbor does not know.

characters.name: Sera Vane
characters.secrets: She wants the archive's west stair opened.

characters.name: Keeper Noll
characters.secrets: He moved the oil stores and fears dismissal.
